epic.title: Class & Curriculum Configuration
epic.body: Core academic structure management allowing admins to define classes, map subjects to curriculums, and assign class responsibilities to teachers.

features.title: Class Registry & Lifecycle
features.body: Full CRUD capabilities for Class entities, serving as the foundational containers for students and timetables.

stories.title: Create Class API
stories.body: Endpoint to create a new class entity with name, section, and initial subject configuration.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /classes accepts name, section, and academicPeriodId
Validates uniqueness of Class Name + Section pair within the organization
Returns 201 Created with the new class object

stories.title: Fetch Class List API
stories.body: Endpoint to retrieve all classes for the current organization/branch, optimized for list views.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /classes returns a list of class objects
Response includes aggregated counts (e.g., total students) if required for the UI
Supports optional filtering by Academic Year

stories.title: Update Class Details API
stories.body: Endpoint to modify existing class details, including renaming or changing sections.
acceptanceCriteria: PUT/PATCH /classes/{id} updates allowed fields (Name, Section)
Prevents updates that result in duplicate Class Name + Section pairs
Logs the modification for audit purposes

stories.title: Delete Class API
stories.body: Endpoint to soft-delete a class. Must enforce constraints to prevent deleting classes with active students.
acceptanceCriteria: DELETE /classes/{id} checks for active student enrollments
Returns 409 Conflict if students are still enrolled
Performs soft delete (sets isDeleted flag) if safe

stories.title: Class Management UI (List, Create, Edit)
stories.body: Implement the Class grid view and the Add/Edit Modal as per the prototype.
acceptanceCriteria: Display classes in a grid with Teacher and Subject summaries
'Add Class' button opens a modal to enter details
'Edit' button pre-fills the modal with existing class data
Form submission connects to Create or Update API based on context

features.title: Subject & Curriculum Mapping
features.body: Flexible system to define what subjects are taught in a specific class, including the ability to define new subjects on the fly.

stories.title: Dynamic Subject Selector UI
stories.body: Develop the subject input component that supports selecting from existing subjects or creating new ones immediately.
acceptanceCriteria: Autocomplete dropdown filters existing available subjects
User can type a new subject and click 'Add' to create it locally
Selected subjects appear as removable tags

stories.title: Persist Class Subjects API
stories.body: Backend logic to update the list of subjects associated with a class. Handles mapping existing subjects and creating new ones.
acceptanceCriteria: Accepts list of Subject IDs or Names
If a Subject Name is provided without an ID, create the Subject master record first
Updates the link between Class and Subjects (M2M relationship)

features.title: Class Teacher Assignment
features.body: Designate a specific teacher as the 'Class Teacher' responsible for the section.

stories.title: Assign Class Teacher API
stories.body: Backend endpoint to assign or re-assign a teacher to a specific class.
acceptanceCriteria: PATCH /classes/{id}/teacher accepts a teacherUserId
Validates that the user exists and has the 'TEACHER' role
Updates the class record with the new teacher ID
Handles removal of teacher if teacherUserId is null

stories.title: Teacher Selection Interface
stories.body: Integrate the 'Class Teacher' dropdown in the Class Modal with the user list.
acceptanceCriteria: Dropdown fetches users where role = 'TEACHER'
Displays teacher names clearly
Pre-fills existing assignment when editing a class
Updates the class payload with the selected teacher ID
